valuation_policy.use: Calibrate fictional player market values and transfer-market behavior; do not copy or claim Transfermarkt valuations for fictional players.

distinction.market_value: Estimated medium-term player value under normal market conditions.
distinction.transfer_fee: Negotiated transaction price; affected by contract, seller/buyer finances, demand, clauses and timing.
distinction.wage: Recurring employment cost, not player market value.

valuation_policy.update_cycle: At season end and mid-season; event-driven updates for breakout form, long injury, transfer or contract change.
valuation_policy.confidence: Generated fictional player values are game estimates, not real-world appraisals.

player_value_model.note: Starting tuning parameters only; calibrate against licensed or publicly documented comparable market data, then validate gameplay economy.

third_kit.activation: A third kit is unlocked only when the first-division club has an active contract covering the current season and all design/brand rights are cleared.
third_kit.expiration: Lock the third kit for new selections after contract expiry; preserve historical kit records for archived seasons.
third_kit.no_contract: Only home, away and goalkeeper kits are selectable; third-kit slot remains visibly locked.

data_provenance.real_player_values: Only import Transfermarkt values if permitted by applicable terms/licensing; store source, retrieval date, currency and attribution.
data_provenance.fictional_player_values: Generated internally using the documented model; never label them as Transfermarkt data.
data_provenance.other_assets: Transfermarkt is not a source for stadium construction costs, sponsor deals, ticket prices, kit manufacturing costs or club enterprise values; use separate documented assumptions and game balancing.
